messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

已查到可引用的部分資料：

**Binding R&S technical basis**: use formal CMX500 specifications / option evidence, because the CMX500 specs are the binding source while the Features and Functions document is an overview and “data without tolerance limits is not binding.” [11] The “one-box tester” language is positioning; formal hardware configuration, software option stack, measurement specifications and order numbers still need confirmation from official CMX500 specs / configurator sources [1].
**Exact signaling / non-signaling scope**: cite the supported R&S capabilities, such as NR FR1 / FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurement [2].
CMX500 Callbox use cases include RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance and non-signaling R&D verification [4].
Example use cases also include non-signaling verification [21].
If pass/fail or lifecycle claims are made, separate evidence is needed because the source does not define pass/fail standards for Go-NoGo, Non-Sig, Conformance or R&D testing [36].
The existing AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping only records sales / test-solution leads from an Excel table and does not prove formal product configuration, customer relationship or validated opportunity [12].
Existing AI data center ecosystem imagery also cannot by itself support market share, adoption status, supply-chain relationship or R&S relationship claims [18].
The current R&S CMX500 vs Keysight material is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [7].
The comparison table itself notes that Keysight official data is missing for several claims, Keysight roadmap claims need official evidence, and some workflows / option codes are not formally listed [23].
**Like-for-like test conditions and metrics**: any comparison should state the same DUT, RAT / band, signaling or non-signaling mode, options, calibration state, environmental conditions, warm-up, tolerance limits and measured metrics, because CMX500 product data is conditional on warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval and internal adjustments, and R&S distinguishes guaranteed specifications from non-guaranteed typical, nominal and measured values [11].
**No unsupported advantage claim**: do not claim “better,” “only,” “more integrated,” or “AI-ready” versus a competitor unless the same claim is supported by binding R&S evidence plus official competitor evidence; the current battle-card comparison is not enough because it is explicitly sales positioning and lacks official competitor substantiation [7][23].

[1] Wiki：CMX500 NTN one-box tester（來源：`CMX500_Callbox.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`…）

answer.question: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

passages.text:
CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 來源定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing。
- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。
- 來源宣稱 users can test all NTN technologies on both network and device level without multiple instruments。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將於 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] booth 5A80 / hall 5 展示 upgraded one-box tester，活動期間為 2026-03-02 至 2026-03-05。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Comprehensive support for NR-NTN。
- Multi-orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Complete channel emulation in one box。
- Live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters。
- NB-NTN coming end of `25。
- Option 線索：[[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

此處的 one-box tester 是 PR / solution positioning 與簡報 use-case 語彙；正式 hardware configuration、software option stack、measurement specification 與 order number 仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]] 與正式 configurator。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Qualcomm › 來源中的說法
- [[Taiwan CPE Industry 2024]] 的 5G FWA CPE Supply Chain Architecture 將 Qualcomm 與 [[MediaTek]]、RF houses 同列於 upstream：5G SoCs、RF modules、antennas、ICs。
- [[Taiwan CPE Industry 2024]] 的 Chipset Competitive Landscape 說 3Q 2024 chip market value 為 USD 139.9 million。
- 同一來源說 [[MediaTek]] vs. Qualcomm 的 market share gap 在 2024-2025 narrowing。
- 同一來源說 Qualcomm focus on AI integration、advanced broadband device features。
- 同一來源說 2025 outlook 是 chip price decline、intensified platform competition。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Phison PS5031-E31T › Performance claims
[[ProductBrochure_Consumer_PS5031-E31T_040825]] 的 controller-level performance claims：

| 指標 | 數值 |
|---|---:|
| Sequential Read | up to 10,600 MB/s |
| Sequential Write | up to 9,500 MB/s |
| 4K Random Read | up to 1,500K IOPS |
| 4K Random Write | up to 2,200K IOPS |

來源同時明示 performance numbers may vary based on system configuration and testing conditions，因此這些數字不可脫離測試條件引用。

Samsung Electronics › 來源中的說法
- [[TRI_AMD_RSKR Sharing1]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-18）Slide 11 customer 欄為 Samsung Electronics(Foundry RF/Analog Enablement Group)。
- Products 欄列出 [[R&S FSWP50]]、[[R&S SMW200A]](44GHz)、SGS100A。
- Competitor 欄列出 Keysight E5052B、VXG。
- DUT 欄為 5G SoC including VCO。
- USP 欄為 Performance(Fast/precise), Supports from AE。
- 來源寫 RSK AE has developed and provided automated VCO Tuning S/W。
- 圖中文字可辨識 Semi-auto Probe Station from FormFactor。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors
[[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 中列出的 [[Amphenol Communications Solutions]] featured product，來源稱 Celerity / Celerity LP 支援 up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity
[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

AI 資料中心高壓直流供電
[[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 是 [[Infineon]] 白皮書 [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）用來描述 AI 伺服器機架從 `48 V` 生態系轉向 `800 V` 或 [[±400Vdc]]，並在伺服器主板本地轉換至 GPU / 處理器低壓供電的架構方向。[[SST(Solid State Transformer ) image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）也在概念圖中把 [[Data Center]] 應用標示為 **800 VDC**，並以圖說稱 [[SST]] technology 受到 **AI data centers** 帶動。

[[Infineon]] 是多份市場來源中的 power electronics / semiconductor 公司名稱；在 2024-09 [[Power Systems Design]] BBU 文章讀圖來源中，Infineon 被連到 data center [[BBU]] converter topology、low-power [[DP-CF-SUSD]] board、[[OptiMOS]] MOSFET 與 [[EiceDRIVER 2EDB]] gate driver；在 10/2025 白皮書中則提出 AI 資料中心從電網到核心的供電架構。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 相關工具與 package
來源明示或描述下列工具 / package：

- [[Constellation Insight Tool]]：用於 real-time constellation visualization、mobility management、trajectory observation、digital twin of the live sky、automated deployment and handovers、ephemeris data integration 與 complex handover scenarios。
- [[XLAPI]] Python Test Case package：包含 Starlink [[LTE-DTC]] scenarios，例如 LTE attach time / success rates、Event A3 handover、cell reselection 與 RLF recovery。
- [[ScriptAssist]]：AI-powered script generation tool，用於加速 NTN-specific R&D protocol and application testing 以及 instrument automation 的 scripting。
- [[R&S CMX-KS627B]]：[[CMX500_Callbox]] 中列為 NR Signaling Extension Rel-17，用於 NTN slide 的 option 線索。

Qualcomm › 可追溯範圍
- 可支持：[[Taiwan CPE Industry 2024]] 在 2024 Taiwan 5G FWA CPE industry analysis 中把 Qualcomm 列為 upstream / chipset competitive landscape 相關名稱。
- 可支持：該來源將 Qualcomm 的 focus 描述為 AI integration 與 advanced broadband device features。
- 不可支持：Qualcomm 的具體 FWA chipset 型號、market share、shipment、customer list、price、benchmark、正式供應關係或 legal entity mapping。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

RF RRM conformance outlook Q2 2026
[[RF RRM conformance outlook Q2 2026]] 是 [[Q2_2026 Conformance & NetOp Updates_Customer]] 對 RF / RRM conformance market status、competitor position 與 future demand 的 internal product-highlight 摘要。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

Keysight
[[Keysight]]（圖中亦寫作 [[是德科技]]）是在既有 PCB 測試圖像來源中被列為高頻高速 [[PCB]] 測試解決方案相關公司的測試量測廠商名稱；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中，Keysight 也被描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 wireless device testing 競品供應商。

- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]]（來源未標示日期；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 featured product 區塊列出 Celerity / Celerity LP 224 Gb/s BGA Mezzanine Connectors。
- 來源稱 Celerity and Celerity LP 224 Gb/s BGA Mezzanine Connectors are designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

**Binding R&S technical basis**: use formal CMX500 specifications / option evidence, because the CMX500 specs are the binding source while the Features and Functions document is an overview and “data without tolerance limits is not binding.” [11] The “one-box tester” language is positioning; formal hardware configuration, software option stack, measurement specifications and order numbers still need confirmation from official CMX500 specs / configurator sources [1].
**Exact signaling / non-signaling scope**: cite the supported R&S capabilities, such as NR FR1 / FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurement [2].
CMX500 Callbox use cases include RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance and non-signaling R&D verification [4].
Example use cases also include non-signaling verification [21].
If pass/fail or lifecycle claims are made, separate evidence is needed because the source does not define pass/fail standards for Go-NoGo, Non-Sig, Conformance or R&D testing [36].
The existing AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping only records sales / test-solution leads from an Excel table and does not prove formal product configuration, customer relationship or validated opportunity [12].
Existing AI data center ecosystem imagery also cannot by itself support market share, adoption status, supply-chain relationship or R&S relationship claims [18].
The current R&S CMX500 vs Keysight material is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [7].
The comparison table itself notes that Keysight official data is missing for several claims, Keysight roadmap claims need official evidence, and some workflows / option codes are not formally listed [23].
**Like-for-like test conditions and metrics**: any comparison should state the same DUT, RAT / band, signaling or non-signaling mode, options, calibration state, environmental conditions, warm-up, tolerance limits and measured metrics, because CMX500 product data is conditional on warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval and internal adjustments, and R&S distinguishes guaranteed specifications from non-guaranteed typical, nominal and measured values [11].
**No unsupported advantage claim**: do not claim “better,” “only,” “more integrated,” or “AI-ready” versus a competitor unless the same claim is supported by binding R&S evidence plus official competitor evidence; the current battle-card comparison is not enough because it is explicitly sales positioning and lacks official competitor substantiation [7][23].

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 來源定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing。
- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。
- 來源宣稱 users can test all NTN technologies on both network and device level without multiple instruments。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將於 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] booth 5A80 / hall 5 展示 upgraded one-box tester，活動期間為 2026-03-02 至 2026-03-05。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Comprehensive support for NR-NTN。
- Multi-orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Complete channel emulation in one box。
- Live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters。
- NB-NTN coming end of `25。
- Option 線索：[[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

此處的 one-box tester 是 PR / solution positioning 與簡報 use-case 語彙；正式 hardware configuration、software option stack、measurement specification 與 order number 仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]] 與正式 configurator。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。

- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。
